title: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
abstract: arXiv:2610.14397v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. translated_title: RealityBench：用于评估视觉语言模型记录人类体力工作能力的模拟环境
translated_abstract: 通过指导来增强工人在物理世界中的能力，一直是AI智能体数十年来的目标。其中一个关键的支持能力是理解工人正在做什么——通过人类佩戴的相机或智能眼镜进行观察，并协助他们进行工作记录。尽管视觉语言模型已经取得进展，但它们在这些场景中的能力仍然不确定，且难以进行基准测试，因为大多数体力工作数据是专有的，且变异性太大，无法以系统化、有原则的方式进行 研究。与厨房和仓库等光照、几何结构和物体都可预测的结构化环境不同，屋顶太阳能安装和车辆维修等面向现场的任务是无约束且高变异的。在此工作中，我们在Blender中模拟了真实世界的体力工作，涵盖十一个环境，并纳入了图像可接受性和工作记录两个方面的变体。可接受性任务询问某个特定视角是否……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RealityBench基准，通过在Blender中模拟十一个真实体力工作环境，评估视觉语言模型在协助记录人类物理工作（包括判断图像可接受性和生成工作文档）方面的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RealityBench, a benchmark using eleven simulated real-world physical work environments in Blender to evaluate vision language models' ability to document human physical work, including image acceptability and documentation tasks.
